name: Restaurante El Camarón Jackie
address: Playa Karabalí s/n, Costera Miguel Alemán, Hornos

tagline.es: Pescado a la talla frente a la playa

specialty: Classic Acapulco beachfront seafood: whole red snapper a la talla, house shrimp specials and big family platters.

photo_notes.cover: Open-air beachfront seafood restaurant on Playa Karabalí, tables under palapa shade facing the bay, sand and gentle waves.
photo_notes.s1: Whole butterflied red snapper grilled a la talla, half red chile adobo and half green herb, with rice, salad and lime.
photo_notes.s2: Plump shrimp in a glossy reddish house sauce with white rice and fresh salad on a white plate.
photo_notes.s3: Halved pineapple filled with sautéed shrimp, bell peppers and onion, served on a tropical table.
photo_notes.s4: Large family seafood platter with garlic, diabla and breaded shrimp, octopus, grilled fish, sopes and pescadillas.
